name: User Management Workflow Template
description: Comprehensive delegated user administration covering user profile lifecycle, group memberships, role assignments, user attributes, folder access, credentials/sessions, and user-scoped telemetry & schedules.

user_id_limitation.description: Limitation enforcing user ID scoping across all user management operations

mode.description: 'scope_groups_minus_privileged' (default) restricts to users in the invoking admin's active Scope Groups excluding Looker Admins and Service Accounts; 'scope_groups' restricts to users in the invoking admin's active Scope Groups; 'exclude_privileged' allows all users except Looker Admins and Service Accounts; 'self' restricts to the invoking user; 'none' applies no user ID scoping

attribute_name.description: User attribute name set on Looker Groups for Scope Group matching

profile.description: Controls for core user profile lifecycle and account status mutations

credentials.description: Controls for email credentials, password reset emails, 2FA/TOTP resets, and session revocation (API3 credentials are never exposed)

groups.description: Controls for viewing and editing group memberships within the admin's active Scope Groups and their descendant subgroups

roles.description: Controls for viewing effective roles and assigning direct user roles bounded by the invoking admin's effective permissions/models

user_attributes.description: Controls for viewing and setting user-level attribute overrides with allowed/blocked lists and value rules

folder_access.description: Controls for viewing and granting/revoking user folder access on folders accessible to the admin's Scope Groups

telemetry.description: Controls for viewing per-user query/schedule/CA/folder telemetry and managing user scheduled plans
